rough-riders-top-of-hill.description: [Colonel Roosevelt and his Rough Riders at the top of the hill which they captured, Battle of San Juan] — 1 photographic print : albumen. — Creator: Dinwiddie, William — Date: 1898

charge-san-juan-painting.description: [Charge of the Rough Riders at San Juan Hill] — Reproduction of painting by Frederic Remington showingTheodore Roosevelt, on horseback, with his men running close behind him; some men are being shot while others lay dead in the grass. — Creator: Remington, Frederic — Date: 1956
